item.title: Warmest weekend since December begins now
item.description: A cold front brought gusty winds and a warm weekend, with temperatures expected to reach the 60s on Sunday and Monday, followed by a cold front and a chance of showers midweek.

item.title: This week's Springfield historical headlines: 1926 & 1976, Jan. 2-6
item.description: The History Museum on the Square and Sharing Stories of the Crossroads has preserved stories from a century ago, including the completion of the steel work for a new theatre, the appointment of a new Director for Elfindale Academy, and the use of recorded bird sounds to scare away starlings in the city.

item.title: Reach out and touch faith! Depeche Mode - Violator Album Review
item.description: Depeche Mode's 1990 album "Violator" was the band's first to chart in the top 10 of the Billboard 200, and featured singles such as "Personal Jesus", "Enjoy The Silence", "Policy of Truth" and "World in My Eyes".

item.title: Explore Springfield: Top attractions and must-try restaurants
item.description: Springfield, Missouri offers a diverse array of attractions, from the First Friday Art Walk to the Springfield Cardinals, and a wide variety of cuisines from around the world, making it a great destination for travelers.

item.title: Springfield businesses feel strain as city prepares new Route 66 monument
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Springfield is moving forward with plans to install a new Route 66 monument — a 20‑foot illuminated crown called Queen’s Gate 66 — but nearby businesses say construction and road closures are already taking a toll. item.title: Temperature records may fall as warming trend takes hold
item.description: A warming trend is expected to bring temperatures into the 60s and 70s over the next few days, with a chance of isolated showers, before a more unsettled and soggy pattern develops in the second half of the week.

item.description: WAYNESVILLE, Mo. — An Army specialist has been sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole for the premeditated murder of a fellow soldier at Fort Leonard Wood.
